Demo Movie was scanned in 4K from an original 1971 UK X-Rated scope 35mm print. The print was unfaded and in excellent condition overall. In comparison to the UK retail DVD of the same version (there is no official Blu-Ray release), the 35mm source print looses only 2s 08fr over 9 splices including each of the seven reels heads & tales making it virtually complete.


Re-synced and added the following from the Demo Archive 2-Disc Special Edition (PAL DVD9) DVD:

- English SDH subtitles
- Audio commentary with Demo Director, Demo Critic, Demo Editor & Demo Interviewer
